item.title: Scale Lane footbridge: next phase of investigations announced ahead of repair programme
item.description: Hull City Council has announced the next phase of investigation work on Scale Lane footbridge will start later this month (January). item.title: Emergency removal of carved Hull 2017 tree stump in Pearson Park
item.description: Hull City Council has carried out the emergency removal of the carved Hull 2017 tree stump in Pearson Park. The sculpture, ‘Whispering Sweet Nothings’, created by artist Julian Barnard during Hull’s year as UK City of Culture in 2017, was carved from the remaining stump of a dead tree that had been partially felled around ten years ago.
